thread:
Maya CS: Quick heads-up — Satori's onboarding batch enroll p95 jumped from ~95ms to ~220ms in last 24h. Renewal call tomorrow; usage looks flat. Recommend a short proactive perf pilot: int8 quant + route 10% to a dedicated pool with auto-fallback. Need sign-offs and brief customer consent text.

Adarsh RM: Any eval regressions on their prompt set?

Maya CS: Small — model-checker shows ~0.7% detokenize diffs on edge cases only. Not seen in primary flows.

Jin Eng: I can build artifact "int8-ux1" and create a 10% traffic-split rollout with fallback to fp16. Will add monitoring hooks.

Lucas SRE: I can reserve a tiny dedicated pool in us-west-2 for 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight and enable detailed tracing.

Eve PM: Product requests a one-pager for Satori (benefits, rollback, opt-out) and an in-app micro-survey after the window. Keep messaging simple.

Maya CS: Draft plan:
1) build int8-ux1 artifact
2) deploy 10% canary on dedicated pool
3) monitor p95, token-loss, detokenize-errors for 6h
4) pass iff QoE delta <1% AND p95 <120ms -> ramp to 100% within 24h
Approve?

Jin Eng: Approve. Rollout snippet: `traffic_split:{"int8-ux1":0.1,"fp16-stable":0.9}, fallback:fp16-stable, monitor:[p95,token-loss,detokenize-errors]`

Lucas SRE: Alerts: token-loss >0.5% OR p95 regression >20% = immediate rollback. Adding capacity toggle.

redwood-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-7890 at 2026-04-12T02:00Z by Jin Eng

Maya CS: I'll request consent: 'We will run a short performance canary with automatic rollback if quality is impacted.' Will log reply in account thread.

Adarsh RM: Sending renewal note + mitigation checklist to procurement.

Jin Eng: Will post logs to #eng-runtime and ensure >=500 requests/variant for statistical confidence.

Maya CS: Also enabling 1-question micro-survey to capture subjective feedback from affected sessions.

Eve PM: No objections. Proceed. :thumbsup:

Lucas SRE: Approved.

Adarsh RM: Approved.

Jin Eng: Approved.

Maya CS: Approved. Kicking off artifact build and scheduling; will report results.
